Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck
and low back pain and stiffness. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with
the nature and force of the collision. Examination findings showed paraspinal muscle
tenderness and restricted range of motion in the cervical and lumbar regions, and
imaging studies clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to both areas. No prior injury
or treatment to the same body regions is known to this provider. Care was delivered
over trhee visits consisting of evaluation, manual therapy, and a home stretching
program, following a typiacl course for this type of strain. Symptoms improved
steadily with each visit, and treatment was tapered accordingly as function returned.
Billing records reflect single chagres for each service, with no duplicate or repeated
billing. Prognosis is good with continued self-directed exercise, and the patient was
discharged to follow up as needed.
